description: Fetch a short-lived signed download URL for one output index of a track inside a play session. Path param variant_index is the delivery/output index (historical name). Only succeeds when the session was created with is_downloadable true (and the API key allows downloads); otherwise the API returns 403. Authorized by the play_session_id. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_get_play_download
